meta.title: Bulk Vendor Upload: refused for a user without the Implementation Partner role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Implementation Partner role and attempt Bulk Vendor Upload from an Excel vendor list deduped on PAN.
Repeat Bulk Vendor Upload as an Implementation Partner and verify the action is available and can be completed.
Compare the two role-based outcomes or determine whether tenant RBAC grants the capability to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Implementation Partner role and attempt Bulk Vendor Upload from an Excel vendor list deduped on PAN.; Repeat Bulk Vendor Upload as an Implementation Partner and verify the action is available and can be completed.; Compare the two role-based outcomes or determine whether tenant RBAC grants the capability to additional roles.

args.need: in the same tenant, sign in as a user without the Implementation Partner role, attempt Bulk Vendor Upload using an Excel vendor list deduped on PAN and record whether it is refused or absent, then repeat as an Implementation Partner and record whether the upload is available and succeeds

steps.note: No catalog step can sign in as role-specific users or operate and assert the Bulk Vendor Upload flow.
Provides the closest available final assertion that the resulting screen has no crash or server error, but does not assert the role-based permission outcome.
